name: farmvoice
description: FarmVoice — voice-controlled greenhouse dashboard: talk to your greenhouse (AssemblyAI Voice Agent demo)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @farmvoice/shared && npm run build -w @farmvoice/api && npm run build -w @farmvoice/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @farmvoice/shared && npm run typecheck -w @farmvoice/api && npm run typecheck -w @farmvoice/web
